reference.question: Calculate \(\sqrt{16}+\sqrt[3]{27}-\sqrt{4}\).
reference.solution:
Method 1: Evaluate the roots

\(\sqrt{16}=4\), \(\sqrt[3]{27}=3\), and \(\sqrt{4}=2\). The original expression equals \(4+3-2=5\).
